request.description:
Get data for a specific load under a user. The load_uuid that you want to receive should be placed at the end of the URI, and it must be an existing load for the cust_id referenced after "load_menu/" in the URI.

Authorization should be the id_token received when authenticating, and passed in the headers under the "Authorization" key.
